verdict.rationale: Sentry has a first-party documentation page titled "Webhooks" under its Integration Platform (sentry-docs-25), which indicates a native outbound webhook capability. The pack gives only the page title, so event types, registration, payloads, and signing are unevidenced. Slack and PagerDuty notification integrations do not count toward this story. Missing for 10: documented event types and subscription/registration flow, payload schema and signature verification details, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
